StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterSideTurnEnd.issue: SLOT. AbstractModel.AfterSideTurnEnd is dispatched by Hook.AfterTurnEnd (Hook.cs:1267-1292), called for the player side at CombatManager.cs:1307 -- AFTER the turn-end card effects and the hand flush. The sim's on_player_turn_end is Hook.BeforeTurnEnd (combat.py:654), which runs BEFORE _process_turn_end_cards (combat.py:658) and before the flush (combat.py:661-662); the sim's real AfterTurnEnd slot, after_player_turn_end (combat.py:665), is available and unused. THE CONCRETE ROUTE, which applies to every unit in this group: StampedePower (powers.py:1025-1041) auto-plays Attack cards from ITS on_player_turn_end, i.e. inside the very same dispatch, and _process_turn_end_cards runs more card effects immediately after. So in the game every turn-end auto-play happens while this power is still on the creature, and in the sim whether it does depends on hook-registration order between this power and Stampede. Reproduce the affected population with `py audit/tools/power_census.py slots`. Third-file citations, not hashed here. LIVE for this unit: Rage blocks on every Attack the owner plays, and Stampede's turn-end auto-plays are Attack plays, so in the game they each grant Rage block and in the sim they do so only if Rage is registered after Stampede. Both are ported Ironclad card powers (cards/rage_card.py-shaped applier and powers.py:1017-1041).
